description: The macOS Beebeeb window (`main`, task 1683 slice 1; spec docs/specs/2026-10-24-macos-two-surface-app.md §4, §7): Home and Settings in one window. macOS only, because no other platform builds it. The same grants as the default capability: its toolbar and sidebar top are a `data-tauri-drag-region` (start-dragging), and it reads and listens like every other app window.
